source.notes: Four buildings rotated around a square courtyard, with four open corner passages. Drone orbit, overhead and March rooftop views; dimensions remain a photographic fit.

bands.note: low prisms = geometry within the ground body band; .up = above it (overhead). No walkable decks/stairs: none are declared by the procedural scene.
